about_blocks.text: Ray of Hope serves vulnerable people struggling with hunger, homelessness, poverty, and other challenges. We provide life-changing health and social services; and a welcoming, compassionate community. We empower people to chart a new path in life by nurturing their own God-given skills.

about_blocks.text: Ray of Hope is a trusted rehab centre in Kitchener, Ontario, that helps individuals recover from drug and alcohol addiction. Their comprehensive approach is designed to treat the root cause of addiction and provide the support and tools necessary for a successful recovery. Ray of Hope specializes in substance abuse and offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices such as individual and family counseling, group therapy, and nutritional counseling.
